plan.paired: same 37 patient draws for every method, encoder and SAE seed
plan.selection: original validation-eligible training-usage ranking; IDs frozen before bootstrap
plan.models: fixed historical baseline encoders/SAEs; no refitting or reselection
plan.top10: recomputed from all resampled positive activations; repeated patients/slices retain multiplicity
plan.ties: descending activation, original slice order, then repeated-copy index
plan.missing: do not replace/drop selected IDs; retain [0,1] purity bounds if positive support <10
plan.strict_interval: 2.5/97.5 percentiles on fully scorable replicates, only if >=95% replicates defined
plan.outer_envelope: 2.5th percentile of gap lower bound to 97.5th percentile of gap upper bound; not guaranteed nominal coverage
plan.scope: conditional exploratory validation uncertainty; excludes fitting/selection uncertainty and does not create new patients
